title.en: List IPsec policies on your PC
title.hinglish: Apne PC par IPsec policies dekho

why.en: Read-only view of the IPsec security associations your own machine currently has.
why.hinglish: Aapki apni machine ke paas abhi kaunse IPsec security associations hain, uska read-only view.

expect.en: On a machine without an IPsec/IKEv2 VPN connected you usually get an empty result. With a VPN up you see the peer addresses, the cipher (for example AES-GCM) and SPI values like those in the lesson. Output varies.
expect.hinglish: Jis machine par IPsec/IKEv2 VPN connected nahi hai wahan aksar result khaali aata hai. VPN up ho to peer addresses, cipher (jaise AES-GCM) aur lesson jaise SPI values dikhte hain. Output alag ho sakta hai.

why.en: Open the downloaded .pcap and look at the IKE_SA_INIT and IKE_AUTH exchanges.
why.hinglish: Download kiya .pcap kholo aur IKE_SA_INIT aur IKE_AUTH exchanges dekho.

expect.en: You see IKE_SA_INIT request and response, then encrypted IKE_AUTH messages. Expand the SA, KE and Nonce payloads in the first packet.
expect.hinglish: IKE_SA_INIT request aur response, phir encrypted IKE_AUTH messages dikhte hain. Pehle packet mein SA, KE aur Nonce payloads expand karo.

why.en: Shows only the encrypted data packets, with their SPI and sequence numbers.
why.hinglish: Sirf encrypted data packets dikhata hai, unke SPI aur sequence numbers ke saath.

expect.en: You see ESP packets (or UDP 4500 packets that contain ESP). The payload cannot be read; only the SPI and the increasing sequence number are visible.
expect.hinglish: ESP packets (ya UDP 4500 packets jinme ESP hai) dikhte hain. Payload padha nahi ja sakta; sirf SPI aur badhta hua sequence number dikhta hai.

why.en: In the proposal-mismatch capture the gateway answers with Notify type 14.
why.hinglish: Proposal-mismatch capture mein gateway Notify type 14 se jawab deta hai.

expect.en: One packet matches: the gateway's NO_PROPOSAL_CHOSEN reply. The normal capture has no such packet.
expect.hinglish: Ek packet match karta hai: gateway ka NO_PROPOSAL_CHOSEN reply. Normal capture mein aisa koi packet nahi hota.
